description: This file is a PHP class defining a controller for an HTML module extension in the OpenCart admin interface. It includes methods for rendering, saving, and managing the module settings, with interactions involving loading language packs, handling requests, managing module data, and rendering views.

classes.name: HTML
classes.description: Controller class for managing the HTML module in OpenCart's admin extension. Implements methods for rendering the module page, saving settings, and handling data associated with the module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the module configuration page, sets up data including breadcrumbs, module info, languages, and includes common sections like header, footer, and sidebar. It also loads necessary scripts and styles.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the module configuration. Validates permissions, processes POST data, adds or updates the module, and returns a JSON response indicating success or error.
